{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check premises
premise_1 = (df['customer_segment'] == 'new').any() and (df['channel'] == 'paid_search').any()
premise_2 = df['channel'].isin(['email', 'paid_search']).all()
premise_3 = df['converted'].isin([0, 1]).all()

# Print results
print(f"Premise 1 (new customers and paid_search exist): {premise_1}")
print(f"Premise 2 (channel only has email/paid_search): {premise_2}")
print(f"Premise 3 (converted is 0 or 1): {premise_3}")

# Check for QA orders and refunded orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']

print(f"Number of QA orders (should be 6): {len(qa_orders)}")
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Inspect the first few rows
print("\nFirst 5 rows:")
print(df.head())

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 in customer_age: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")"}
